title: Log redact
skill: List every secret and the exact mask

good: Rewrite redact(record) in logkit/redact.py as a recursive function that returns a new object and never mutates its input. Dict: for each key, if key.lower() is exactly one of password, token, secret, api_key, the value becomes "***" (any type); otherwise recurse. List: recurse into each item. String: first replace re (?i)\b(bearer\s+)\S+ with \1*** (so 'bearer abc' -> 'bearer ***'), then mask emails: keep the first character of the local part and the domain, 'ana.lee@example.com' -> 'a***@example.com'. Other values (numbers, bool, None) and all keys stay as they are. Only change logkit/redact.py. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
lazy: Our logs leak passwords and tokens. Make redact() safer.
